d: Magnus Carlsen sees Javokhir Sindarov as the favourite. Hikaru Nakamura expects a one-sided match. Even the ratings suggest that the Uzbek grandmaster has the edge over India's D Gukesh. But a World Chess Championship is not won on ratings, predictions or reputation. Gukesh has been through the pressure of a title match before, defeating Ding Liren in Singapore to become the youngest world champion in history. Now he must defend that crown against a challenger in the form of his life. Rupha Ramani looks at whether Gukesh can turn the underdog tag into his biggest strength.
